EnvStore API (0.1.0)

Download OpenAPI specification:

URL: https://github.com/fenilsonani/envstore License: MIT

Secure environment variable management API with end-to-end encryption.

Authentication

Most endpoints require API key authentication via the x-api-key header.

Rate Limiting

All endpoints are rate-limited to prevent abuse. Rate limit headers are included in responses.

Caching

The /v1/env/latest endpoint uses Cloudflare KV caching with a 60-second TTL.

Environment Variables

Environment variable management endpoints

Get latest environment file

Retrieve the latest encrypted environment file for a specific project and environment.

This endpoint is cached with a 60-second TTL for improved performance. Check the X-Cache header to see if the response was served from cache.

Authorizations:
ApiKeyAuth
query Parameters
projectId
required
string <uuid>

Project UUID

environment
required
string
Example: environment=production

Environment name (e.g., development, staging, production)

Responses

Development server

http://localhost:3000/api/v1/env/latest

Production server

https://envstore.app/api/v1/env/latest

Response samples

  • 200
  • 400
  • 401
  • 404
  • 429
Content type
application/json
{
  • "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  • "version": 0,
  • "ciphertext": "string",
  • "iv": "string",
  • "salt": "string",
  • "checksum": "string"
}

Upload environment file

Upload a new version of an encrypted environment file.

You can either:

  • Provide plaintext content and passphrase (server-side encryption)
  • Provide pre-encrypted data (client-side encryption)

The upload automatically increments the version number and invalidates the cache.

Authorizations:
ApiKeyAuth
Request Body schema: application/json
required
One of
projectId
required
string <uuid>

Project UUID

environment
required
string

Environment name

content
required
string

Plaintext environment file content

passphrase
required
string >= 8 characters

Encryption passphrase (minimum 8 characters)

Responses

Development server

http://localhost:3000/api/v1/env/upload

Production server

https://envstore.app/api/v1/env/upload
